question: What transformative effect does meditating on the Mother have on a dull-minded person?
premises: The practitioner meditates on the Mother
Even a dull-minded person performs this meditation
The result is becoming a poet
inference: Meditation on the Mother transforms even a dull-minded person into a poet.
plain_english: O Mother, even a dull-minded person, meditating on you, becomes a poet.
